_meta.purpose: Deterministic country-fit scoring for a Pakistani-national Industrial Engineer. Feeds the Location/Remote (5%) and Visa (5%) components of the Phase 3 match score.
_meta.derived_from_user_instruction: We have to consider whole world but best will be English spoken countries or countries where English language can enough to live and have good Muslim majority to survive.
_meta.scope_rule: WORLDWIDE. No country is filtered out by this file. Every value here is a RANKING bonus, never an exclusion. A strong role in a low-scoring country still appears in results; it simply scores lower on 10% of the total.

IMPORTANT_DATA_PROVENANCE_NOTICE.what_is_factual: Country names, ISO codes, aliases and major cities are factual reference data.
IMPORTANT_DATA_PROVENANCE_NOTICE.what_is_a_judgement: The three band assignments (english_usability, muslim_life, visa_pathway_pk) are BUILD-ASSIGNED JUDGEMENTS, not measured facts. They are recorded as named bands with a stated basis so they are auditable and arguable, rather than as invented precise percentages.
IMPORTANT_DATA_PROVENANCE_NOTICE.what_was_deliberately_left_null: Exact Muslim-population percentages are null everywhere. Writing precise figures from memory is exactly the fabrication Rule 1 forbids. Run scripts/load_pew_religion_data.py with a real Pew Research dataset to populate muslim_population_pct properly.
IMPORTANT_DATA_PROVENANCE_NOTICE.verification_status: visa_pathway_pk.verified_against_official_source is false for every country. Immigration rules change frequently and none of these were checked against the official portal during this build. Each entry carries official_source_url so it can be confirmed before you rely on it.
IMPORTANT_DATA_PROVENANCE_NOTICE.how_to_challenge_a_score: Every band maps to a number in scoring_model.bands. Change a band or a band weight in this file and every affected score changes; nothing is hardcoded in Python.

scoring_model.weights_rationale: English is weighted highest because it is the precondition the user named first and it gates both work and daily life. Muslim-community practicality is a close second per the user's 'good Muslim majority to survive'. Visa pathway is weighted lowest of the three not because it matters least, but because it is the most volatile and least verified input here - it should not dominate a ranking built on unconfirmed data.

native_official.definition: English is an official language and the ordinary language of daily life and work.

working_language.definition: English is not the majority home language, but it is the de-facto language of business, professional workplaces and expatriate life. An engineer can work and live without the local language.

widely_used_secondary.definition: English is common in professional and urban settings; local language helps but is not required for a multinational workplace.

high_proficiency_non_official.definition: High general English proficiency; many employers run in English, but daily bureaucracy and social life expect the local language.

limited.definition: English rarely sufficient outside specific multinational teams; local language effectively required.

minimal.definition: English of little practical use for work or living.

muslim_majority.definition: Muslim-majority country. Mosques, halal food, prayer accommodation and Islamic holidays are the societal default.

large_established_minority.definition: Large, long-settled Muslim community. Halal food and mosques are readily available in most cities; workplace prayer accommodation is common and usually uncontroversial.

established_minority.definition: Recognised Muslim community concentrated in major cities. Halal food and mosques available in urban centres; may be limited in smaller towns and regional areas.

small_minority.definition: Small Muslim population. Halal food and mosques exist in capitals and largest cities only; practice requires planning.

minimal.definition: Very small or negligible Muslim community; little to no halal or mosque infrastructure.

employer_sponsored_routine.definition: Employer-sponsored work visas for Pakistani nationals are routine, high-volume and comparatively fast. Large existing Pakistani workforce.

points_based_available.definition: An open skilled-migration route exists that a Pakistani engineer can use without a job offer, subject to a skills assessment and a valid English test.

employer_sponsored_available.definition: A functioning employer-sponsored route exists, but requires a licensed/registered sponsor and is more selective.

employer_sponsored_competitive.definition: A route exists but is capped, lottery-based or heavily oversubscribed.

employer_sponsored_hard.definition: Legally possible but rare in practice for this profile.

restricted.definition: Effectively closed to a Pakistani national in this occupation.

not_applicable_home.definition: Home country - unrestricted right to work.

unknown_country_policy.behaviour: If a posting's location cannot be resolved to a country in this list, the country_fit component is recorded as UNSCORED with reason 'country_unresolved'. It is NOT defaulted to zero and NOT defaulted to an average - either would be an invented number. The Phase 3 scorer redistributes the weight and states that it did.
unknown_country_policy.rationale: Rule 4: every score must be explainable. An unresolved location cannot be scored, so it is reported as unscored.

worldwide_remote.treatment: A genuinely worldwide-remote role is scored on english_usability of the EMPLOYER's country only; muslim_life is scored against Pakistan (the candidate's country of residence) because he would be living there; visa_pathway is scored as not_applicable_home.
worldwide_remote.rationale: Remote work from Pakistan means daily life happens in Pakistan. Scoring such a role on the employer's country's mosque density would be meaningless.

region_locked_remote.treatment: Scored as if onsite in the required region, because the candidate must be resident there to hold the role.
